summary: loanDepot, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026 (event date October 2, 2026) disclosing that indirect subsidiary loanDepot.com, LLC, as seller and servicer, and its wholly-owned loanDepot Multi Asset NC, LLC entered a Master Repurchase Agreement with Nomura Corporate Funding Americas, LLC as buyer. The facility provides up to $125 million of aggregate uncommitted financing for residential mortgage loans and, subject to conditions precedent, real estate owned (REO) interests, expiring September 30, 2027. It is a routine secured warehouse/repo financing with customary margin-cure and default acceleration terms; no corporate ownership or control change arises.
